description: Sends the supplied reply text to one existing recruiter conversation under the account holder's identity. Sending requires explicit consent and an unambiguous thread; otherwise the result is a confirmation hold containing the draft. Sent mail cannot be recalled. Threads whose ids begin with inbound: cannot receive replies through this endpoint.

body.description: The full reply text, as it will be sent.

confirmationToken.description: Echo the token from a previous `held` result to carry out the act it described — only after the person has seen that result's summary and agreed to it. Send identical arguments: the token is bound to the exact call it was issued for, so a changed argument is held again with a fresh token and a fresh summary. It lasts two minutes and is spent once.

name: reply_to_recruiter
title: Reply to a recruiter
